data.title: Ethereum’s ‘World Computer’ Has A Privacy Problem, Charles Hoskinson Says As Midnight Eyes AI Agents
data.description: Ethereum (ETH) was wrong with its “world computer” idea, Cardano (ADA) founder Charles Hoskinson said.
